title: Pure Bamboo Sword
summary: Pure Bamboo Sword Equip Spell control and draw strategy revolving around Cursed Bamboo Sword, Golden Bamboo Sword, and Warrior synergy, supported by generic staples. By chaining Golden Bamboo Sword for continuous draws and combining Burning Bamboo Sword with Terminal World, the deck establishes an oppressive turn-skip lock while beating down with buffed Warriors.

summary.title: Starters
points: Foolish Burial Goods sends Cursed Bamboo Sword directly from Deck to GY to search any Bamboo Sword card (such as Golden, Broken, or Burning Bamboo Sword).
Reinforcement of the Army searches Infernoble Knight - Renaud or Fire Flint Lady to assemble Warrior bodies on field.
Infernoble Knight - Renaud Special Summons itself from hand while you control a FIRE Warrior and adds a banished or GY Equip Spell back to your hand.
Cursed Bamboo Sword can return another Bamboo Sword card you control to hand to allow an equipped monster to attack directly, and searches any Bamboo Sword card whenever it is sent to the GY.

summary.title: Opening: Foolish Burial Goods + Warrior
steps: Activate Foolish Burial Goods, sending Cursed Bamboo Sword from your Deck to the GY.
Trigger Cursed Bamboo Sword in the GY to add Broken Bamboo Sword (or Cursed Bamboo Sword) to your hand.
Normal Summon Silent Swordsman LV3 (or Infernoble Knight - Renaud).
Equip Broken Bamboo Sword to your monster.
Activate Golden Bamboo Sword to draw 2 cards without restrictions.
Activate Burning Bamboo Sword and Terminal World to skip both the opponent's Main Phase 1 and Main Phase 2 on their upcoming turn.

summary.title: Bosses & Control
points: Immortal Phoenix Gearfried Special Summons itself by banishing an Equip Spell from field or GY, equips an opponent's attacking monster to itself, and sends an equip to negate a monster effect.
S:P Little Knight provides versatile Link-2 removal, banishing a card on field or GY on summon and temporarily banishing two monsters as a Quick Effect.
Cross-Sheep enables Link climbing and stat manipulation or revival when extra deck monsters are summoned to its arrows.
Silent Swordsman LV3 negates any opponent Spell card that targets it, providing an immune equip host.

summary.title: Spells & Traps
points: Golden Bamboo Sword draws 2 cards while you control a Bamboo Sword Equip Spell, offering unconditional draw power that is not once-per-turn.
Burning Bamboo Sword is a Continuous Spell that skips the opponent's next Main Phase 1 whenever you activate a Bamboo Sword card.
Terminal World prevents both players from entering Main Phase 2; combined with Burning Bamboo Sword, the opponent cannot play cards during any Main Phase.
Original Bamboo Sword equips from Deck when the equipped monster deals battle damage and destroys all opponent monsters.
Soul Devouring Bamboo Sword is a Continuous Trap that skips the opponent's next Draw Phase when the equipped monster inflicts battle damage.
